chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: His four teachers: Aunt Edna, Tiger Flowers, J. D. and Bubbles
summary: Green says he asked his aunt, Tiger Flowers, J. D. and Bubbles for explanations, and Flowers said he was the student.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Yeah. In the muscles, you see. And then, as I said, we were still growing lads, and that's what he did. And all during these times I was very inquisitive, you see, because whenever I wanted anything explained to me that I thought wasn't an actual fact, I would ask my aunt, Edna May Sanders, 'Am I doing it right?' or 'Am I correct?' or 'Is it a good idea to do it this or that way?' you know. So I had -- actually I had three -- well, four teachers, I mean

to myself they were teachers, because I would ask Tiger Flowers questions about, like rhythms, you know, and he would always say, "Well, I'm the student and you're teacher." He couldn't explain the rhythms to me, the way that Mr. Bubbles did, or either J.D., Chuckles.
